verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a hosted inference platform, but the evidence describes only Baseten-managed infrastructure: managed GPUs, MCM provisioning, and deployment to Baseten. The open-source Truss library packages model servers, but it is a developer building block that pushes to Baseten, not a self-hostable version of the core platform, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
